L106: 【38†Inkigayo】 Chart winners (2024)
L107: ---
L108: Highlights
L109: ---
L110: Artist(s) with most wins  | 【39†Aespa】 (8)
L111: Song with highest score  | "【40†Love Wins All】" by 【41†IU】 (8,808)
L112: 【41†IU】's single "【40†Love Wins All】" accumulated 8,808 points on the February 4 broadcast, making it the single with the most points of the year. The single also earned a Triple Crown.
L113: The 【38†Inkigayo】 Chart is a 【42†music program】 【43†record chart】 on 【44†Seoul Broadcasting System】 (SBS) that gives an award to the best-performing 【45†single】 of the week in South Korea. The show aired every Sunday at 3:20 p.m. KST and was broadcast from the SBS Open Hall in 【46†Deungchon-dong】, 【47†Gangseo-gu, Seoul】.^{【48†[1]】}^{【49†[2]】} Every week, the show awards the best-performing single on the chart in the country during its live broadcast.
L114: In 2024, the chart measured digital performance in domestic online music services (5,500 points), social media via 【50†YouTube】 views (3,000 points), album sales (1,000 points), network on-air time (1,000 points), advanced viewer votes (500 points), and live viewer votes (500 points).^{【51†[3]】} Beginning on October 6, 2024, Inkigayo implemented changes to its ranking methodology.
L115: The weighting for domestic online music services was reduced from 5,500 points to 5,000 points, and points for social media views, were decreased from 3,000 to 2,000 points, while the other criteria remained unchanged. Songs that spend three weeks at number one are awarded a 【52†Triple Crown】 and are removed from the chart and ineligible to win again.
L116: Since July 3, 2023, 【53†Tomorrow X Together】 member 【54†Choi Yeon-jun】, 【55†BoyNextDoor】 member Woonhak, and actress 【56†Park Ji-hu】 had been hosting the show and continued to do so till April 14, 2024. Actor 【57†Moon Seong-hyun】, 【58†Zerobaseone】's Han Yu-jin, and 【59†Ive】's Leeseo were announced as new hosts of the show the following week.^{【60†[4]】}
L117: In 2024, 21 singles reached number one on the chart and 17 acts were awarded a first-place trophy for this feat.
L118: Seven songs collected trophies for three weeks and earned a Triple Crown: 【39†Aespa】's "【61†Drama】", "【62†Supernova】", and "【63†Whiplash】",^{【64†[5]】}^{【65†[6]】}^{【66†[7]】} 【41†IU】's "【40†Love Wins All】",^{【67†[8]】} 【68†(G)I-dle】's "【69†Fate】" and "【70†Klaxon】",^{【71†[9]】}^{【72†[10]】} 【73†Illit】's "【74†Magnetic】",^{【75†[11]】} and 【76†Rosé】 and 【77†Bruno Mars】's "【78†APT.】".^{【79†[12]】} Aespa's "Drama" was the first number one on the chart in 2024.
L119: The single kept its number one spot for one more week, which helped it achieve a triple crown, having ranked number one on the November 26, 2023, broadcast. The group had two more number one singles on the chart in 2024 achieved with "Supernova" and "Whiplash", both of which ranked number one for three weeks each and achieved triple crowns. The three songs spent a combined total of eight weeks atop the chart, one making Aespa the act with most weeks at number one in 2024.
L120: Soloist IU's single "Love Wins All" had the highest score of the year on the February 4 broadcast with a total of 8,808 points. Girl group (G)I-dle topped the chart twice in 2024 with "Fate" and "Klaxon," both of which earned Triple Crowns.
L121: Boy group 【80†Riize】 had their first ever number one on the chart on the January 21 broadcast with their single "【81†Love 119】".^{【82†[13]】}^{【83†[14]】} They were immediately followed by another first-time number one single, "【84†Dash】" by 【85†Nmixx】.^{【86†[15]】} Both groups ranked one more single at number one in 2024: Riize with "【87†Boom Boom Bass】" and Nmixx with "【88†See That?】".
L122: Riize and Nmixx were among a number of acts to reach number one for the first time in 2024. In March, both 【89†Bibi】 and 【90†TWS】 reached number one for the first time with "【91†Bam Yang Gang】" and "【92†Plot Twist】", respectively.^{【93†[16]】}^{【94†[17]】} Other first-time number one artist includes Illit, whose debut single "Magnetic" reached number one on the April 21 broadcast.^{【95†[18]】} The single went on to rank number one for three consecutive weeks and achieved a triple crown.
L123: In September, Zerobaseone, BoyNextDoor, and 【96†Day6】 won their first ever Inkigayo trophy with their singles "【97†Good So Bad】", "Nice Guy", and "Happy", respectively.^{【98†[19]】}^{【99†[20]】}^{【100†[21]】} Finally, "APT." helped American singer-songwriter Bruno Mars rank number one for the first time on the October 27 broadcast. The single went on to achieve a triple crown.^{【101†[22]】}
L124: ## Chart history
L125: 
L126: [【102†edit】]
L127: 
L128: 【39†Aespa】 had three number one singles on the chart in 2024, achieved with "【61†Drama】", "【62†Supernova】" and "【63†Whiplash】". All three singles went on to achieve triple crowns. They spent a total of eight weeks atop the chart making them the artist with the most weeks at number one in 2024.
L129: 
L130: Four boy groups received their first major broadcast music show wins on Inkigayo in 2024 (from top to bottom): 【90†TWS】, 【58†Zerobaseone】, 【55†BoyNextDoor】, and 【96†Day6】.
L131: Girl group 【73†Illit】 had their first number one and triple crown on Inkigayo with their debut single "【74†Magnetic】". 【89†Bibi】 had her first number one on the chart on the March 17 broadcast with her single "【91†Bam Yang Gang】".
L132: 
L133: 【76†Rosé】 (left) and 【77†Bruno Mars】 (right) earned their first triple crown and the latter his first number one for "【78†APT.】".
